title: Failed Request Timeline: Debug Panel and Payload Inspector
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Design a compact, vertically-scannable Debug Panel in Redwood Console that surfaces failed requests with a chronological timeline, granular error taxonomy, automatic retry visualization, and an inline payload inspector that respects PII redaction policies. This work should reduce mean-time-to-diagnose for SRE/Platform engineers and product teams while keeping user data safe.

Background: Current Console pages show isolated error samples and logs but lack a unified, time-ordered view that ties retries, fallback model switches, and payload diffs together. Teams have asked for a single pane that shows the story of a failed request (initial request, retries, downstream fallbacks, and final outcome) and quick actions (replay, export, create incident).

Scope:
- New Debug Panel layout (collapsible side panel and full-screen expansion) with request timeline and event markers.
- Error taxonomy chip bar (network, model, rate-limit, quota, internal) with per-event tags.
- Payload inspector supporting structured and raw views, with configurable redaction toggles and a safe-preview mode for non-admins.
- Retry visualization showing times, durations, and outcomes; hover to reveal stack traces / kernel selection logs.
- Quick actions: Replay (sandboxed), Create Issue (pre-fill template), Export (JSON/CSV), and Open in Traceboard.
- Prototype and a11y pass, including keyboard navigation for timeline events.

Out of scope for this ticket: backend retention changes, long-term storage UI for archived traces (separate PM/ENG work).
acceptance_criteria: Design comps for both side panel and full-screen modes reviewed and approved by PM and Eng
Figma prototype includes interactive timeline with hover states and payload inspector toggles
Redaction behavior documented with examples (admin vs read-only user states)
Accessibility checklist completed (keyboard focus, color contrast, screen reader labels)
Spec includes API contract notes for engineers: which fields are required and how pagination of events should work
engineering_notes: Prefer incremental rendering for timeline: server returns events page-by-page; UI streams event pages to keep initial render <200ms
Payloads may be large; recommend implementing size cap + preview extraction endpoint that returns first N keys and hashes for large blobs
API contract: GET /console/requests/:id/events?page=1&limit=50; each event includes timestamp, event_type, error_code, metadata_links
Backend should provide pre-redacted and raw payloads. UI will request raw payloads only for users with redact_bypass permission
Consider performance cost of live replay action — require quota check and sandboxed execution channel
